task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: Navigate to the FRONT_CRATE obstacle, pick it up, and place it on TEMP_ZONE to clear the path. Then navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, pick it up, navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, and place the bottle on the table.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the CAR.
TEMP_ZONE is a valid and reachable location to place the removed obstacle.
The robot can only hold one object at a time, so the obstacle must be placed down before picking up the medicine bottle.
The interaction distance of 2.0 is sufficient for pick/place operations when the robot is navigated within a tolerance of 0.5.
